Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 1) The definitive method of sex determination in doubtful cases is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Gonadal biopsy can confirm the presence of testicular or ovarian tissue. It is definitive in doubtful sex determination.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 2) The gold standard for sex determination is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Chromosomal analysis or karyotyping is considered the gold standard for sex determination. It directly identifies chromosomal sex.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 3) The best single bone for sex determination is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Pelvis is the most reliable single bone for sex determination. It shows marked differences due to childbirth adaptation in females.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 4) Accuracy of sex determination from pelvis is approximately:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Sex determination from pelvis gives about 75–80% accuracy. Accuracy improves when pelvis is combined with other bones.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 5) Accuracy of sex determination without pelvis is approximately:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Without pelvis, skeletal sex determination becomes less reliable. The file mentions about 50% accuracy without pelvis.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 6) The best combined skeletal method for sex determination is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Combining pelvis, skull, sternum and long bones improves accuracy. Pelvis remains the most reliable single bone.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 7) The most reliable skeletal feature for female sex is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Greater sciatic notch is an important feature for female sex determination. In females, it is wider than in males.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 8) Greater sciatic notch in female pelvis is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female pelvis has a wide greater sciatic notch. Male pelvis usually has a narrow greater sciatic notch.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 9) Greater sciatic notch in male pelvis is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male pelvis is heavy and narrow, with a narrow greater sciatic notch. Female pelvis is wider and more spacious.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 10) Subpubic angle in male pelvis is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male pelvis has a narrow V-shaped subpubic angle, usually less than 70°. Female pelvis has a wider U-shaped angle.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 11) Subpubic angle in female pelvis is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female pelvis has a wide U-shaped subpubic angle, usually more than 80–90°. This helps in sex determination.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 12) Female pelvic inlet is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female pelvis has an oval or rounded pelvic inlet. Male pelvic inlet is usually heart-shaped.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 13) Male pelvic inlet is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male pelvic inlet is classically heart-shaped. Female pelvic inlet is wider and oval or rounded.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 14) Female pelvic cavity is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female pelvic cavity is wide and shallow. This is related to childbirth adaptation.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 15) Male pelvic cavity is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male pelvis has a narrow and deep pelvic cavity. Female pelvis is broader and shallower.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 16) Female pelvic outlet is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female pelvic outlet is large. This is one of the important pelvic differences used in sex determination.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 17) Male obturator foramen is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male obturator foramen is large and oval. In females, it is smaller and triangular.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 18) Female obturator foramen is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female obturator foramen is small and triangular. Male obturator foramen is large and oval.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 19) General build of male pelvis is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male pelvis is generally heavy, thick and rough. Female pelvis is lighter, thinner and smoother.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 20) General build of female pelvis is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female pelvis is lighter, thinner and smoother than male pelvis. It is also wider and shallower.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 21) Male mandible is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male mandible is large and heavy, with square chin and broader ascending ramus. Female mandible is smaller and lighter.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 22) Female mandible is usually:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.option4: Small with rounded or pointed chin
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Female mandible is smaller and lighter, with rounded or pointed chin. Male mandible is heavier with square chin.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 23) In mutilated body, if genital organs are present, sex is first determined by examining:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: In a mutilated body, genital organs should be examined if present. If only skeleton is available, pelvis is most reliable.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 24) In skeletal remains, the most reliable bone for sex determination is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: In skeletal remains, pelvis is the most reliable bone for sex determination. Skull is next useful after pelvis.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 25) After pelvis, the next useful bone for sex determination is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: If pelvis is unavailable, skull is commonly used for sex determination. However, pelvis remains more reliable.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 26) Strong evidence of being male is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Testicles with emission containing spermatozoa provide strong evidence of male sex. It directly supports functional male gonadal status.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 27) Strong evidence of being female is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Functional ovary with menstruation is strong evidence of being female. It shows functional female gonadal activity.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 28) Davidson body and Barr body are usually found in:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Barr body and Davidson body represent sex chromatin and are found in females. They are used in forensic sex determination.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 29) Barr body is formed by:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Barr body is formed by an inactive X chromosome. It is the sex chromatin seen in normal females.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 30) Barr body is commonly seen in:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Barr body is seen in buccal mucosal cells. It is used as a simple forensic method for sex chromatin detection.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 31) Barr body is present in:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Barr body is present in normal females with XX chromosomes. It is absent in Turner syndrome because there is only one X chromosome.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 32) Female with absent Barr body suggests:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Turner syndrome has 45, XO karyotype, so there is no inactive X chromosome. Therefore, Barr body is absent.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 33) Male with Barr body suggests:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Klinefelter syndrome has 47, XXY karyotype. The extra X chromosome forms a Barr body.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 34) Davidson body is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Davidson body is a drumstick-shaped nuclear appendage. It represents sex chromatin in neutrophils of females.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 35) Davidson body is found in:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Davidson body is found in neutrophils of females. It is demonstrated on peripheral blood smear.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 36) Davidson body is demonstrated on:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Davidson body is seen on peripheral blood smear. Barr body is commonly looked for in buccal mucosal cells.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 37) Presence of both ovarian and testicular tissue in the same individual is:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: True hermaphroditism means presence of both ovarian and testicular tissue. It is currently termed ovotesticular disorder of sex development.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 38) True hermaphroditism is currently termed:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: True hermaphroditism is now termed ovotesticular disorder of sex development. It contains both ovarian and testicular tissue.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 39) Pseudohermaphroditism means:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.option1: Gonads of one sex with external genitalia resembling opposite sex
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.option2: Presence of both ovarian and testicular tissue
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: In pseudohermaphroditism, genotype and gonads belong to one sex, but external genitalia resemble the opposite sex or are ambiguous.

Sex Deteemination, Intersex.question: 40) Male pseudohermaphroditism commonly has:
Sex Deteemination, Intersex.exp: Male pseudohermaphrodite has 46, XY karyotype and testes, but external genitalia may be female or ambiguous. A common cause is 5α-reductase deficiency.
